description: This file contains a color picker implementation for TinyMCE editor, including color conversion, color generation, and UI interaction functions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the color picker, sets up the UI, and applies input color if provided.

methods.name: insertAction
methods.description: Inserts the selected color into the TinyMCE editor and closes the popup.

methods.name: showColor
methods.description: Displays the selected color and its name in the UI.

methods.name: convertRGBToHex
methods.description: Converts an RGB color string to hexadecimal format.

methods.name: convertHexToRGB
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to an RGB object.

methods.name: generatePicker
methods.description: Generates the color gradient picker UI.

methods.name: generateWebColors
methods.description: Generates a table of predefined web colors.

methods.name: generateNamedColors
methods.description: Generates a list of named colors.

methods.name: dechex
methods.description: Converts a decimal number to a two-character hexadecimal string.

methods.name: computeColor
methods.description: Calculates color based on user interaction with the color gradient.

methods.name: updateLight
methods.description: Updates the lightness gradient based on selected color.

methods.name: changeFinalColor
methods.description: Sets the final color and updates the UI.
